**The moment** (where you are in the game and what gets in the way, as in "the shop screen is
too small in the side panel")

**What it should do** (a layout, a control, a setting)

**Why the existing layouts and keys do not cover it** (CONSOLE, AUTO, FOCUS, SIDE, STACKED, Tab…)

Keep in mind what sims2-ds-wide will not do: ship or download anything from the game, or tell
anyone where to get it. Never attach a ROM, a save or a save state; a screenshot is fine.
